title: satureja varia subsp. meridialis
intro: Satureja varia subsp. meridialis, commonly known as the 'Meridional Savory', is a subspecies of perennial herb in the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Satureja varia subsp. meridialis include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antiseptic, and carminative, making it useful for treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
